description: CPU-only EdgeBench wiring smoke for Plain Codex and Goal Plus + Codex.

protocol_override_reasons.agent: the smoke includes Goal Plus wiring in addition to the official plain Codex agent
protocol_override_reasons.backend: the local smoke uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the smoke uses the selected development model
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: reasoning effort is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the lifecycle smoke uses a five-minute task budget
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: the smoke concurrency is a wiring check rather than three paper trajectories
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the local controller runs one task-method cell at a time
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
